evals.name: classify-profile
evals.prompt: Declare a registration and projected member profile with a personal name and email.
evals.expected_output: Protected values at the event and projection destinations.
assertions: Classifies the reusable name concept with PII and a reason.
Classifies the scalar email on both event and read model.
Uses a surrogate ID rather than an email address as the member's event source ID.

evals.name: release-profile
evals.prompt: A query reads an encrypted member profile directly from the application's database collection. Show when and how to release it.
evals.expected_output: Release only for an authorized caller and a present profile.
assertions: Checks that the read model exists.
Uses ReadModels.Release rather than returning raw protected values as readable data.

evals.name: forget-member
evals.prompt: Erase one member's protected values while preserving another member's values.
evals.expected_output: A subject-key erasure with a control.
assertions: Selects the intended namespace and subject for DeleteEncryptionKeyFor.
Checks unreadability of the erased values and readability of the other subject's values.
Does not promise erasure of backups or previously released copies.
